provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: Nothing has been executed, so this has not been checked against the fixtures or fresh pairs. The main search assumes the constructor's domain: tiles 4-6 cells, offset 1-2 from the original leading edge, spacing 1-2, and copies = (N-2)//(t+s). Grids outside that domain use the density-threshold fallback, which can fail when noise is dense. The fallback crops tiles to the smallest band size if detected bands differ. Majority ties never occur in generator output; if one did, the solver would pick the smallest colour value, which may differ from the generator's choice. I found no contradictions between the fixtures and the rule.
